blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Structural and Computational Biology) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is structural biology? What information does it provide?
(Structural biology kya hai? Yeh kya maloomat deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Structural biology macromolecules, jaise proteins aur nucleic acids, ki teen-jehti (3D) structures ka atomic satah par mutaala hai. Yeh biomolecule ki structure, kaam, dynamics aur ligands aur doosre macromolecules se raabte ki tafseeli maloomat deti hai.

book_ref.quote: It provides the detailed information about the structure of biomolecule

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between the polymerase domain and the RNase H domain of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase.
(HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ke polymerase domain aur RNase H domain mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono HIV-1 reverse transcriptase ke structural mutaale se pehchane gaye domains hain:

book_ref.quote: structural studies of the enzyme HIV-1 reverse transcriptase have identified its polymerase domain

rows: RNA-DNA hybrid ka RNA strand torta hai

blocks.prompt:
3 What does the structure of serine proteases reveal?
(Serine proteases ki structure kya dikhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Serine proteases ki structure aik wazeh active site dikhati hai jo peptide bonds torne ki zimmedar hai.

book_ref.quote: which is responsible for breaking down peptide bonds

blocks.prompt:
4 What are drug targets? How does structural biology help to find them?
(Drug targets kya hain? Structural biology inhein dhoondne mein kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Drug targets bimari paida karne wale molecule par woh jagahein hain, aksar proteins, jahan dawa kaam kar sake. In proteins ki 3D shakal parh kar scientists woh khaas jagah dhoondte hain jahan dawa jur kar protein ka kaam rok de.

book_ref.quote: Structural biology helps scientists find the right place on a disease-causing molecule where a drug can work

blocks.prompt:
5 How was structural biology used against COVID-19 to design vaccines and medicines?
(COVID-19 ke khilaf vaccines aur dawaayein banane mein structural biology kaise istemal hui?)
blocks.explanation: Scientists ne SARS-CoV-2 ke spike protein ka mutaala kiya jo virus ko insani cells mein dakhil karta hai. Is ki 3D structure jaan kar use drug target banaya aur aisi vaccines aur dawaayein banayin jo spike protein ko rok kar virus ko mazeed cells infect karne se rokti hain.

book_ref.quote: By knowing its 3D structure, scientists identified it as a drug target

blocks.prompt:
6 What is host–pathogen interaction? How does structural biology study it?
(Host–pathogen interaction kya hai? Structural biology is ka mutaala kaise karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Host–pathogen interaction pathogens (viruses ya bacteria) ka host ke jism ke cells se raabta hai. Pathogen aur host cell dono ke proteins ki 3D structures parh kar scientists dekhte hain ke pathogen host cell se kaise chipakta aur andar jata hai aur kaun se molecules shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Structural biology also helps in understanding how pathogens

blocks.prompt:
7 How can a drug that binds with the receptor protein of human cells prevent a viral infection?
(Insani cells ke receptor protein se jurne wali dawa virus ki infection kaise rok sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insani cells par aik protein virus ke spike protein ka receptor hai. Jo dawa is receptor protein se jur jaye woh virus aur receptor ka raabta rok deti hai aur yun virus host cells mein dakhil nahi ho paata.

book_ref.quote: This information was vital in developing the drugs that can bind with receptor proteins

blocks.prompt:
8 Why is correct folding of proteins important? Name two diseases caused by protein misfolding.
(Proteins ki sahi folding kyun zaroori hai? Protein misfolding se hone wali do bimariyon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Proteins ka kaam un ki sahi 3D folding par munhasir hai, is liye ghalat folding bimari laati hai. Misalein: cystic fibrosis, Parkinson's disease aur Alzheimer's disease (kitaab mein naam ghalat chhape hain). Structural biology folding ke raaste aur misfolding se bimari ka tareeqa samjhati hai.

book_ref.quote: The functionality of proteins depends on the correct folding into three dimensional shapes

blocks.prompt:
9 Who developed X-ray crystallography? Name four kinds of substances it has been used to analyse.
(X-ray crystallography kis ne banayi? Chaar qisam ki cheezon ke naam likhein jin ka is se tajziya hua.)
blocks.explanation: X-ray crystallography William Henry Bragg aur William Lawrence Bragg ne banayi jinhein 1915 mein Physics ka Nobel Prize mila. Is se minerals, namak, dhaaton, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleic acids aur vitamins ka tajziya hua.

book_ref.quote: X-ray crystallography was developed in 1912 by William Henry Bragg and William Lawrence Bragg

blocks.prompt:
10 How does an X-ray beam give information about the structure of a molecule in a crystal?
(X-ray beam crystal ke molecule ki structure ki maloomat kaise deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab X-ray beam crystal par parti hai to us ke atoms aur molecules beam ko khaas simton mein mor dete hain. Mori hui beams ke zaviyon aur shiddat se crystal mein electron density ki 3D tasveer banti hai jis se molecule ki 3D structure banayi jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: The electron density is exploited to create 3D structure of the molecule

blocks.prompt:
11 What is protein crystallization? Why are crystals needed?
(Protein crystallization kya hai? Crystals ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Protein crystallization saaf kiye gaye protein ko thos crystal ki shakal dena hai. Crystals protein molecules ko baqaida dohrai tarteeb mein rakhte hain jo X-ray mein saaf image ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Protein crystallization means turning a purified protein into a solid crystal form

blocks.prompt:
12 How do scientists make protein crystals?
(Scientists protein crystals kaise banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Woh protein ko khaas mahloolon ke saath aahista milate hain jin se protein molecules tarteeb se aapas mein jurte hain. Is mein ghante, din ya hafte lag sakte hain aur temperature, pH aur namak ke concentration ka ehtiyaat se control chahiye. Phir saaf aur mazboot crystal istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: scientists slowly mix the protein with special solutions

blocks.prompt:
13 What is a diffraction pattern? How is it produced?
(Diffraction pattern kya hai? Yeh kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Achha crystal X-ray machine par lagaya jata hai aur mukhtalif zaviyon se us par X-ray beam daali jaati hai. Crystal ke atoms beam ko morte hain aur detectors par diffraction pattern, yani nuqton ka silsila, banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The x-rays beam is bombarded at the crystal at various angles

blocks.prompt:
14 How are the density map and the 3D structure of a protein obtained from a diffraction pattern?
(Diffraction pattern se density map aur protein ki 3D structure kaise milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spots ke zaviye aur shiddat crystal mein atoms ki tarteeb ki maloomat rakhte hain, is liye diffraction pattern se density map banta hai. Phir computational programs data ka riyazi tajziya kar ke use protein ki 3D structure mein badal dete hain.

book_ref.quote: The angles and intensities of these spots contain information about the arrangement of atoms in the crystal

blocks.prompt:
15 Define computational biology. Why is it important?
(Computational biology ki definition likhein. Yeh kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Computational biology kayi uloom ka shoba hai jo computational techniques aur tools se biological masail hal karta hai aur biology, computer science, mathematics aur statistics ko milata hai. Yeh ahem hai kyun ke bare datasets sambhal sakta, chhupe patterns dhoond sakta aur paishgoi ke models bana sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Computational biology is an interdisciplinary field that uses computational techniques

blocks.prompt:
16 What is a proteome? What does proteomics aim to do?
(Proteome kya hai? Proteomics ka maqsad kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Proteome kisi jandaar ke banaye tamam proteins ka set hai. Proteomics, yani proteins aur un ki structure aur kaam ka bare paimane par mutaala, proteome ka naqsha banane aur cell ke kaamon mein proteins ke raabte aur kirdaar samajhne ka maqsad rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Proteins are essential molecules that perform many functions within organisms

blocks.prompt:
17 What is bioinformatics?
(Bioinformatics kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bioinformatics biological data ko sambhalne aur tajziya karne ke liye computer technology ka istemal hai. Is ke tools DNA, RNA aur protein sequences ko mehfooz karne, nikaalne aur tajziya karne mein kaam aate hain.

book_ref.quote: Bioinformatics tools and techniques are used to store, retrieve, and analyze DNA, RNA, and protein sequences

blocks.prompt:
18 How does computational biology help in drug discovery?
(Computational biology dawaon ki daryaft mein kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh mumkin drug targets pehchanne aur biological systems par dawa ke asar ki simulation mein madad deti hai. Yeh dawaon ke proteins aur doosre molecules se raabte ki paishgoi kar ke daryaft ko tez karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Computational biology helps in identifying potential drug targets

blocks.prompt:
19 Write the role of computational biology in genetic research and in evolutionary biology.
(Genetic research aur evolutionary biology mein computational biology ka kirdaar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Genetic research: DNA sequences ke tajziye se bimariyon se juri genetic tabdeeliyan pehchanti hai, un ki genetic bunyad samjhati hai aur personalized medicine tak le jaati hai. Evolutionary biology: tools species ki genetic maloomat mila kar irtiqai rishte dobara banate hain.

book_ref.quote: By analyzing DNA sequences, computational biology helps identify genetic variations associated with diseases

blocks.prompt:
20 What is Ensembl? How is it useful?
(Ensembl kya hai? Yeh kaise mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ensembl aik genome browser hai jo mukhtalif species ke genome sequences, gene models aur comparative genomics ki maloomat deta hai. Yeh genomic data tak pohanch aur use dekhne mein madad deta hai aur genomics aur evolutionary biology ke mutaale mein kaam aata hai.

book_ref.quote: Ensembl helps to access and visualize genomic data

blocks.prompt:
21 What is BLAST? Write its uses.
(BLAST kya hai? Is ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: BLAST (Basic Local Alignment Search Tool) bunyadi biological sequences, jaise proteins ke amino acids ya DNA ke nucleotides, ka muqabla karne wala algorithm hai. Yeh homologous sequences pehchanne, na-maloom genes ka kaam batane aur irtiqai rishton ke mutaale mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is used for comparing primary biological sequence information

blocks.prompt:
22 What is FASTA? Write its uses.
(FASTA kya hai? Is ke istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: FASTA sequence alignment tool hai jo aik query sequence ko sequences ke database se mila kar mushabehat ke hisse dhoondta hai. Yeh protein aur nucleotide databases mein talaash, sequence homology pehchanne aur alignments ke tajziye mein kaam aata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is used for searching protein and nucleotide databases

blocks.prompt:
23 What is sequence homology?
(Sequence homology kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sequence homology mushtarka ajdaad ki wajah se DNA, RNA ya protein sequences ki mushabehat hai. Homologous sequences aik mushtarka asal sequence se irtiqa paa kar bani hain; in ki do bari qismein orthologs aur paralogs hain.

book_ref.quote: Homologous sequences have evolved from a common ancestral sequence

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between orthologs and paralogs.
(Orthologs aur paralogs mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono homologous sequences hain:

book_ref.quote: Paralogs can evolve new functions even if they originally arise from the same ancestral gene

rows: Speciation ke dauran mushtarka asal gene se bani
Aksar species mein wohi kaam rakhte hain
Naye kaam paida kar sakte hain

blocks.prompt:
25 How does sequence homology help in understanding evolution and the function of an unknown gene?
(Sequence homology evolution aur na-maloom gene ka kaam samajhne mein kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Homologous sequences ka muqabla kar ke scientists species ki irtiqai tareekh aur alag hone ka andaza lagate hain. Agar na-maloom gene ya protein kisi maloom kaam wale ka homologous ho to us ka kaam bhi aksar milta julta hota hai.

book_ref.quote: By comparing homologous sequences, scientists can infer the evolutionary history and divergence of species

blocks.prompt:
26 Define structural homology. How does it help in predicting the function of a newly discovered protein?
(Structural homology ki definition likhein. Yeh naye daryaft hue protein ka kaam batane mein kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Structural homology mushtarka ajdaad ki wajah se proteins ya doosre macromolecules ki 3D structures ki mushabehat hai. 3D structure kaam ki ahem maloomat deti hai, aur milti julti structure wale proteins sequences kam milne par bhi aksar milte julte kaam karte hain, is liye yeh naye proteins ka kaam batane mein madad deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Structural homology refers to the similarity in the three-dimensional structures of proteins

blocks.prompt:
27 Why is structural homology important in drug design?
(Dawaayein design karne mein structural homology kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dawaayein aksar khaas protein structures se jurne ke liye banayi jaati hain. Is liye proteins ke structural rishte samajhna zyada mufeed dawaayein banane mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: Understanding the structural relationships between proteins can help in designing more effective drugs

blocks.prompt:
28 Differentiate between sequence homology and structural homology.
(Sequence homology aur structural homology mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono mushtarka ajdaad ki wajah se mushabehat hain:

book_ref.quote: The three-dimensional structure of a protein provides critical information about its function

rows: DNA, RNA ya protein sequences ki mushabehat
Proteins ya doosre macromolecules ki 3D structures ki mushabehat
Milti julti structure aksar milta julta kaam deti hai chahe sequences kam milen
BLAST aur FASTA jaise tools se muqabla
Dawaon ke design mein ahem, kyun ke dawaayein khaas structures ko nishana banati hain
